name: Ripper Demon
passive: Deals up to 5% more damage the lower the target's life points are (×(1 + 0.05 × missing share)).

scroll.name: Death From Above
scroll.description: The Ripper Demon jumps up and its next attack deals 200–320% of its max hit. 20 special move points.

name: Kal'gerion demon
passive: +1% critical strike chance while it is out.

scroll.description: +5% critical strike chance for 60 seconds (all styles). 30 special move points; recasting refreshes the buff.
